'''Fel energy''',<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|54|Fel Energy Irregularities III}}</ref> also called '''chaos magic''',<ref>[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Warcraft_III:_Reign_of_Chaos_Game_Manual#Warlock Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos Game Manual#Warlock]</ref> is demonic [[arcane]] magic.<ref name="Genetic Alteration Anomaly">{{questlong|Alliance|53|Genetic Alteration Anomaly!}}</ref><ref>[[Kil'jaeden and the Shadow Pact]]</ref>

==Characteristics and uses==
[[Blood elves]] are known to use fel magic as an alternative to sate their arcane addiction, although its usage is opposed by the [[high elves]] of the [[Silvermoon Remnant]].<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|9|The Way of Fel}}</ref> The chaotic energies of fel have a corruptive influence on the land, having tainted the regions of [[Felwood]] (which takes its name from the energy that corrupted it)<ref>[[Eridan Bluewind#Quotes]]</ref> and the [[Blasted Lands]]. The magical fluctuations of fel emanating from the [[Dark Portal]] have notably warped the beasts that lurk in the wastes of the Blasted Lands, altering the boars close to the Portal into [[helboar]]s.<ref>[[Engineer Wigglestip#Quotes]]</ref><ref name="Genetic Alteration Anomaly" /><ref>[[Commander Baelos#Quotes]]</ref>

==Warlocks==
Having an innate association with demonology, [[warlock]]s have adopted a connection to the darkest fel energies. Through their understandings of demonology they are able to dominate certain agents of the Burning Legion, such as [[imp]]s, [[voidwalker]]s, [[succubi]], [[felhound]]s, and [[felguard]]s.
